target: deploy NARCLIM rasters to the conveyancing/API Python runtime via R2 startup-download (mirror download_hawkesbury_rasters.py)
findings_summary: 6 NARCliM .nc files (~1.8GB: TXge35 33MBx2, tas ~400MBx2, prAdjust ~490MBx2) FOUND in Downloads, validated via query_narclim_summary (real projections: Sydney heat 15.5->34.8 late-century). R2 access works (bucket nsw-planning-pdfs), narclim/ prefix empty->uploading now. Dockerfile.python CMD runs download_hawkesbury_rasters.py && uvicorn; climate_risk_raster.DATA_DIR is fixed repo/data/narclim (not env-configurable) -> make env-aware (NARCLIM_DIR) so Railway can point at writable /tmp/narclim. Composite degrades gracefully if absent (except FileNotFoundError). No DB writes.
